thread:
maria: Heads up — scheduled kernel upgrade in west-1 (controlplane + inference hosts) on 2049-04-02 02:00 UTC. Maintenance window ~2h. Expect rolling restarts and a 10–20% reduction in west-1 capacity. We'll auto-failover traffic to west-2 where possible. Please read the details below.

maria: Why this? We're rolling a kernel micro-patch to address NIC driver packet reordering under load that caused p99 spikes last month. Patch validated in canary pools.

maria: Important: For the window we will: 1) temporarily disable KV prefix pre-warm; 2) relax west-1 p99 SLO by +200ms; 3) enable regional fallback routing earlier (10% bleed) to keep tail stable.

ajay: Will this impact Dedicated customers pinned to west-1? @maria

maria: Yes — Dedicated instances in west-1 will restart. We've contacted affected account owners and have a mitigation plan (standby capacity in west-2 + optional maintenance exemption). If you own a public route and need an exemption DM me.

sophia: How do I opt a route out? Small checklist pls.

maria: Steps: 1) Console > Deployments > select route > Maintenance tab. 2) Toggle 'Exempt from regional maintenance' and add justification. 3) Run:
```
$ rictl route annotate --route my-service --label maintenance=exempt
```
I'll confirm exemptions manually in #eng-sre before 01:00 UTC.

brooke: Any changes to SLA credits or postmortem requirements? We might hit SLO for a short window.

maria: No SLA credit change. We're formally adjusting monitoring SLOs for west-1 during the window only (p99 relaxed). We will not count this as an incident for postmortem unless there's unexpected service-impact beyond planned thresholds.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance job created: job_id=job-8492, start=2049-04-02T02:00:00Z

oncall-sre: Oncall coverage: @oncall-sre will watch the rollout, @ajay will shadow for Dedicated impacts, @brooke will coordinate comms. Pager rotations unchanged.

engprod: Quick ask — can we run a light loadtest ramp 30 minutes before to baseline? Prefer a 15m rolling RPS spike only.

maria: Agreed. We'll run a 15m light ramp at 01:15 UTC to collect perf baseline. If anyone wants to opt out of the ramp DM me.

sophia: If the failover triggers, what are the expected DNS TTL effects for clients? Any latency blips expected?

maria: TTLs are 30s for our edge routing. Expect transient p50 increase ~30–60ms for affected clients during failover. We will disable client-side retries briefly to avoid request amplification; console flag: 'disable-client-retries=true' for the maintenance window.

ajay: Noted. I'll publish a short notice to status.redwood.ai if we see Dedicated route restarts.

maria: Thanks team. Reminder: exemptions close at 01:00 UTC. Ping me if you need the maintenance exempted. :thumbsup:

brooke: thanks, will check the list.

sophia: thanks!
